plugins.name: subagent-opus
plugins.description: Under a Fable or Mythos main loop, start Agent-tool subagents on Opus.

plugins.name: no-bg-poll
plugins.description: Block sleep-and-read polling of background tasks.

plugins.name: workflow-opus-guard
plugins.description: Under a Fable or Mythos main loop, deny Workflow scripts whose agent() calls do not pin model: 'opus'.

plugins.name: jev
plugins.description: Per-step Jev effort routing for Opus and Mythos (policy.v9): task, step and follow-up effort.

plugins.name: mode
plugins.description: Per-repo general/academic mode: /mode writes .claude/settings.local.json; paper repos get a one-time hint.

plugins.name: fast-jev-compaction
plugins.description: At 90% context, drop old tool calls Jev judges unneeded instead of summarising; AskUserQuestion calls are always kept.
